AQUILON TERMINATORS WITH SOLARITE POWER TALONS

enhancements.name: Not a Shell Wasted
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +1 A.

enhancements.name: Pareldor’s Caducatrix
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the start of any phase, this model heals D3+3 wounds.

rules.name: Gilded Guardians
rules.description:
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, ranged attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Salvus

Additional Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.

stratagems.name: Rapid Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit that was engaged with that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Manoeuvre And Fire
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Tip Of The Talon
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of your unit have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. (Once per battle round, per army) At the start of any phase, you can select one friendly battle-shocked Adeptus Custodes unit within 9" of this model. That unit is no longer battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Shroud of the Hidden Blade
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has:

■ Stealth

■ Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.description:
Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:

■ On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if that model is a Character model:

On a 3+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Character model has used a (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability.
stratagems.effect: Your model can use that (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability one additional time, but not in the same phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.

rules.name: Assemblage of Might
rules.description: In your Command phase, you can select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe unit until the start of your next Command phase. Friendly Adeptus Custodes Character models’ attacks that target a dreadful foe unit have +1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Auric Exemplar
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Cleave 1].

enhancements.name: Flawless Bladework
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

rules.name: Instruments of the Emperor’s Wrath
rules.description:
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units can re-roll charge rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Dacatarai

Additional Effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, -2" from that pile-in/consolidation move.

stratagems.name: Golden Light Of The Moiraides
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make an ingress move.
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

Attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
Enemy units cannot target your unit with snap shooting attacks.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Rapidity
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit ends an advance move.
stratagems.effect: That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Lightning Wrath
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a pile-in move.
stratagems.effect: When making that pile-in move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Auriferous Orb
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Edge of the Blade
enhancements.description:
Adeptus Custodes model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model’s attacks can:

■ Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

■ Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

rules.name: Heralds of the Throne
rules.description:
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units have Fights First.

Favoured Ka’tah: Conservai

Additional Effect: Until the end of the turn, being selected to make an advance/fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: Bearers Of His Light
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Slayers Of Nightmares
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit’s T have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Selfless Service
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes unit within 6" of an enemy unit. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect:
Declare a charge with your unit:

When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Devastating Wounds].

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Magna Imperator
rules.description:
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to attack, that unit’s attacks can:

■ Re-roll one hit roll.

■ Re-roll one wound roll.

Favoured ka’tah: Rendax

Additional Effect: You can select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with your unit and roll one D6:

■ On a 1-2, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

■ On a 3-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

■ On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Impenetrable Bastion
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: In Auramite Clad
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Custodian Wardens units).
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Superhuman Focus
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is not readied.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is readied.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this stratagem more than once per battle round.

enhancements.name: Bane of Abominations
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s attacks that target an enemy CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Castellan’s Mark
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Custodes units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Eagle’s Eye
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only.

■ This model has +1 W.

■ (Once per battle, per army) When attacks are allocated to this model, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has 3+ InSv.

enhancements.name: Emperor’s Light
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon:

rules.name: Martial Mastery
rules.description:
In the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight, that unit’s melee attacks have:

■ [Sustained Hits 1].

■ Or: [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: Superhuman Focus
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is not readied.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is readied.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Shield Of Honour
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry/Mounted unit.
stratagems.effect:
When an enemy model engaged with your unit selects targets, if that enemy model does not select your unit as the target of all of its attacks, that enemy model’s attacks have:

-1 to hit rolls.
-1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Unlimited Endurance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit ends an advance move.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn:

Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault].
That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Swift As The Eagle
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Trusted Sentinel unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: In Auramite Clad
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Custodian Wardens units).
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Prime Target
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks can:

Re-roll one hit roll.
Re-roll one wound roll.
Re-roll one damage roll.

enhancements.name: Arae-Shrike
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. Enemy units that are selected to make an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

enhancements.name: Celeritous Sentries (Upgrade)
enhancements.description:
Trusted Sentinel unit only. (Once per phase, per unit) You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:

■ That use is -1 CP.

■ That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

rules.name: Companion’s Watch
rules.description: While a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Avenge The Fallen
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit that is below starting strength is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks (excluding those made by Character models) have +2 A.

stratagems.name: Emperor's Domain
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.effect:
You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

stratagems.name: Swift As The Eagle
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Trusted Sentinel unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Leonine Ferocity
enhancements.description:
Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour model only. (Once per phase, per army) You can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:

■ That use is -1 CP.

■ That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Lightning Descent
enhancements.description: Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: Fury Of The Emperor
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to declare a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Unleash The Lions
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit that has 2+ models.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a starting strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

rules.name: On Gilded Wings
rules.description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit is unengaged, you can place that unit in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink (one per army) (Upgrade)
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Memento Moritoi (one per army) (Upgrade)
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 A, S and D.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Momentum
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: Honoured Interred
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit has the following ability:
Honoured Interred (Aura): Friendly Adeptus Custodes units within 6" of this unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Unceasing Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit ends an advance move.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault] until the end of the turn.
That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

rules.name: Moritoi Ancients
rules.description:
■ While a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit is at starting strength, that unit has +2 OC.

■ While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below starting strength, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

■ While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below half-strength, that unit’s attacks can:

■ Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

■ Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Huntress’ Eye
enhancements.description: Anathema Psykana model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.description:
Anathema Psykana model only. This unit’s attacks have:

■ +1 to hit rolls.

■ Or: If this unit targets a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit, +1 to hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Psy-Chaff Volley
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Prosecutor squad unit has shot.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is prosecuted until the end of the turn:

Attacks that target a prosecuted unit have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Witchseeker squad unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s [Torrent] attacks have:

+1 A.
Or: If those attacks target a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit, +2 A.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Vigilator squad unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:

[Sustained Hits 1]
Or: [Lethal Hits].

rules.name: Silent Sisterhood
rules.description:
■ When mustering your army, you can select a friendly Anathema Psykana Character model to be your WARLORD.

■ Friendly Prosecutor SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.

■ Friendly Anathema Psykana units have the following ability:

Creeping Dread (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit/below starting strength makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

enhancements.name: Genalchemic Warding
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Unstoppable Destroyer
enhancements.description:
Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. When this unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move:

■ This unit can move up to 4".

■ You can select any consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

rules.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
rules.description:
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, melee attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Kaptaris

Additional Effect: You can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

stratagems.name: Indomitable Guardians
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: No Escape
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: Grim Responsibility
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster].

enhancements.name: Auric Eagle (Upgrade)
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry/Mounted unit only (excluding Terminator units). This unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Sally Forth
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Shield-Captain model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit within 6" of this model. If that unit made an advance move this turn, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

rules.name: Talon Sortie
rules.description:
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to charge.

Favoured ka’tah: Calistus

Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: At Spear's Length
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Gravimetric Grenade
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Inexorable
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to move.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:

M.
Advance rolls and charge rolls.
